ink.$description: Body and heading ink on the signed-in homepage.

muted.$description: Generator hint and explore lede on the mobile explore page.

$extensions.source: Hint 'Press the spacebar to generate color palettes!' color on /generate, and the explore lede at 390px. rgb(82, 82, 82).

primary.$description: Primary button fill. Matches the painted button and the :root --color-primary-600 ramp stop.

$extensions.source: a.btn.btn--primary 'Start the Generator' backgroundColor rgb(37, 99, 235) on https://coolors.co/. The same fill paints 'I accept' and 'Let's go!'. :root --color-primary-600 is #2563eb.

hairline.$description: Header hairline and modal ring, both rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07).

$extensions.source: header boxShadow rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07) 0px 1px 0px 0px. Modal .modal_element boxShadow rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px.

ui.$description: The family every measured Coolors text role resolved to.

$extensions.source: getComputedStyle on body, h1, primary button, generator hex and explore h1. Google Fonts link on the page requests Inter (opsz 14-32, wght 100-900), plus Google Sans Code, IBM Plex Mono and Space Mono, which were not the resolved family on these roles.
